📄 Complete Details & Notification

CMHO Jashpur Final Merit List 2026 has been released on 2 November 2026 by the Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer (CMHO), District Jashpur, Chhattisgarh, for various contractual posts under the National Health Mission (NHM). The district administration has published the final merit lists, selection lists, waiting lists and counselling notice for posts including Staff Nurse, ANM, Radiographer, Dental Surgeon, Laboratory Technician, Medical Officer AYUSH, Junior Secretarial Assistant, Counsellor and other positions. Candidates can download their respective post-wise PDFs from the official district website, jashpur.nic.in. As per the official counselling notice dated 2 November 2026, selected candidates must report for document verification and counselling on 5 November 2026 at 10:30 AM at the Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Jashpur, with all required original documents and two sets of photocopies.

CMHO Jashpur Final Merit List 2026 Download PDF

📄 Complete Details & Notification

APPSC Assistant Professor Phase 3 Shortlist 2026 has been released by the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) on 2 November 2026 for the Assistant Professor Examination 2026 under Advertisement No. 01/2026. The commission has shortlisted 170 candidates for the Interview/Viva-Voce in four subjects: Political Science, Economics, Geography and Hindi. Candidates have been shortlisted on the basis of their Academic Performance Score under Appendix II, Table 3B of the UGC Regulations, 2018. The interviews for these subjects are scheduled to begin on 11 November 2026. Candidates can download the six-page official PDF from appsc.gov.in and search for their application numbers in the respective subject-wise annexures. The commission will announce the admit-card download date separately, while individual interview dates, venues and reporting instructions will be mentioned on the admit cards.

Direct Shortlist PDF:

How to Check Your Application Number in APPSC Assistant Professor Shortlist?

The Phase III shortlist identifies candidates by their application numbers rather than by their names.

The application numbers follow the pattern APE-2026-XXXXX.

  1. Open the official shortlist PDF.
  2. Go to Annexure 12, 13, 14 or 15 for your subject.
  3. Find your application number from the submitted recruitment form.
  4. Compare the complete number, including the prefix and leading zeros.
  5. If using a searchable PDF viewer, use the search function to locate your number.
  6. If searching does not work because the PDF contains scanned pages, inspect the relevant annexure manually.
  7. Confirm the exact application number before treating yourself as shortlisted.

Because the shortlist is not arranged in merit order, the serial number beside an application should not be interpreted as a ranking.

  1. Visit the APPSC official website.
  2. Check the latest notifications for Assistant Professor Examination 2026.
  3. Find the Phase III interview admit-card announcement when released.
  4. Open the official admit-card download link.
  5. Enter the candidate details requested by the portal, if login is required.
  6. Access the interview admit card.
  7. Verify the allotted interview date, time, venue and reporting instructions.
  8. Download and print the admit card.
  9. Follow the document and attendance requirements printed on the admit card.

The commission has not yet specified the exact admit-card login fields in the current shortlist notification.

APPSC Assistant Professor Academic Performance Score Representations

The commission has included an important restriction concerning Academic Performance Score and interview eligibility.

The official notification states that the decision of APPSC regarding candidates' eligibility for admission to the Interview/Viva-Voce will be final.

It further specifies that no additional representation or submission regarding Academic Performance Score or eligibility will be entertained.

Candidates should carefully read this condition before contacting the commission about the shortlisting decision.

Is APPSC Assistant Professor Phase 3 Shortlist a Final Result?

No. The notification dated 2 November 2026 concerns candidates shortlisted to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce.

The shortlisted application numbers do not constitute a final appointment list or final merit ranking.

The commission will conduct the interview process and issue further recruitment announcements according to the applicable selection procedure.

Candidates should wait for a separate official announcement regarding final selection.

The application numbers in the annexures are not arranged in merit order.

Important Instructions for APPSC Assistant Professor Candidates

  • Download the Phase III shortlist PDF dated 2 November 2026.
  • Identify the correct subject-wise annexure.
  • Check your complete application number carefully.
  • Do not interpret the serial number as a merit rank.
  • Note that interviews will begin on 11 November 2026.
  • Wait for the separate admit-card download announcement.
  • Follow the individual interview date, venue and reporting time printed on the admit card.
  • Read all applicable interview terms and conditions.
  • Do not assume that shortlisting guarantees final appointment.
  • Monitor the official APPSC website for further recruitment notifications.

What Happens After APPSC Assistant Professor Phase 3 Shortlist 2026?

Candidates whose application numbers appear in the respective annexures are eligible to appear for the Interview/Viva-Voce, subject to the conditions stated in the notification.

The commission will announce admit-card download details separately.

Shortlisted candidates must attend their interview at the allotted date and venue, following the reporting instructions and other requirements printed on their admit cards.

The current notification does not announce a final selection list or appointment date.

APPSC CCE Provisionally Accepted Candidates List 2026

The APPSC has released a list of candidates whose applications have been provisionally accepted for the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Combined Competitive Preliminary Examination 2026.

Provisional acceptance means the application has passed the current scrutiny stage, subject to the commission's recruitment conditions and subsequent verification.

The commission may examine eligibility documents more thoroughly during the Detailed Application Form (DAF) process associated with the Main Examination.

Candidates should retain their application details and relevant supporting documents for future verification.

Important: Provisional acceptance does not mean that a candidate has passed the Preliminary Examination or qualified for the Main Examination.

APPSC CCE Rejected Candidates List 2026

The commission has also published the rejected applications associated with APPSCCE-2026.

Candidates whose applications have been rejected should check the relevant details and grounds for rejection in the official document.

If the commission permits a representation for the identified issue, candidates must follow the prescribed grievance procedure and submit supporting evidence within the deadline.

Applicants should not assume that submission of a grievance automatically results in acceptance. Any correction or change in status depends on the commission's decision.

How to SC CCE List 2026?

Candidates can follow these steps to check their application status.

  1. Visit the official APPSC website at appsc.gov.in.
  2. Open the Announcements or Notifications section.
  3. Find the notice titled "Notification of Provisionally Accepted and Rejected Applications for APPSCCE (Preliminary)-2026".
  4. Click the relevant PDF link.
  5. Download the application-scrutiny list.
  6. Open the PDF using a suitable reader.
  7. Locate the accepted or rejected candidates section.
  8. Search using your application details or candidate identifier displayed in the document.
  9. Check your application status and any rejection remarks.
  10. Save the PDF for future reference.

How to Raise Grievances Against APPSC CCE Rejected List 2026?

Candidates who find an error in their application-scrutiny status can follow the commission's prescribed procedure.

  1. Download the APPSC CCE accepted and rejected applications PDF.
  2. Locate your application details in the document.
  3. Read the reason or remarks associated with the application status, where provided.
  4. Check the official grievance instructions.
  5. Identify the relevant supporting documents needed for your representation.
  6. Prepare a clear explanation of the issue.
  7. Submit the grievance through the link or email specified by APPSC.
  8. Complete the submission by 3 November 2026 at 5:00 PM, according to the deadline.
  9. Retain a copy of the representation and submission confirmation, where available.

The commission may consider the grievance in accordance with the applicable recruitment rules. Candidates should wait for official communication regarding any revised application status.

Documents Required for APPSC CCE Grievance 2026

Applicants raising an objection should provide documents relevant to the reason for rejection or the disputed application entry.

Depending on the specific issue, supporting documents may concern eligibility, educational qualifications, category claims or application information.

The exact documents and submission format must be taken from the official notification. 

APPSC CCE Preliminary Examination 2026

The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Combined Competitive Examination is conducted for recruitment to various civil service and related posts in Arunachal Pradesh.

The Preliminary Examination is an initial selection stage under the recruitment process.

The current application-scrutiny notification concerns the candidates permitted to proceed towards that stage, subject to the prescribed recruitment conditions.

Candidates should refer to the separate examination calendar, notification and admit-card announcements for examination dates, examination pattern and centre allotment.

APPSC CCE 2026 - Provisional Acceptance and DAF Scrutiny

The published states that the provisionally accepted applications remain subject to detailed scrutiny when candidates are required to submit the Detailed Application Form for the Main Examination.

This means application acceptance is conditional and does not eliminate the obligation to produce valid eligibility documents.

Candidates should ensure that the information originally submitted in their applications is accurate and supported by the required documents.

How to Download RBI Officer Grade B Final Result 2026?

RBI Grade B General Final Result 2026

The RBI Grade B General Cadre Final Result 2026 was declared on 15 October 2026. This recruitment stream has 40 notified vacancies.

RBI has published a roll-number-wise result PDF containing candidates recommended for selection. Candidates should check their roll numbers carefully and follow the instructions in the official result notice.

General Cadre Final Result: Download Official Selection List PDF.

RBI Grade B DEPR and DSIM Final Result 2026

The RBI Grade B recruitment also includes 10 vacancies in the DEPR Cadre and 10 vacancies in the DSIM Cadre.

The final result release confirmed on 15 October 2026 relates to the General Cadre. Candidates awaiting DEPR and DSIM final results should monitor the official RBI recruitment website for their respective selection lists.

Candidates should not confuse the earlier Phase-I or Phase-II results with the final selection results.

RBI Grade B Final Merit List 2026

The RBI Grade B final selection process includes the Phase-II examination and interview. The final merit list is prepared according to the applicable RBI recruitment rules and performance in the prescribed selection stages.

The official result PDF provides the roll numbers of recommended candidates. Inclusion in the result list is subject to the terms, conditions and verification requirements specified by RBI.

What Details Are Available in RBI Grade B Final Result 2026?

Candidates can use the official final result notice and PDF to check the following information:

  • Recruitment name and panel year
  • General Cadre final selection status
  • Roll numbers of recommended candidates
  • Official instructions for selected candidates

Candidates should rely on the official RBI documents for all appointment-related instructions.

What Happens After RBI Grade B Final Result 2026?

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the final selection list should read the accompanying RBI result notice carefully. Subsequent formalities will be governed by the bank's applicable recruitment and appointment conditions.

Candidates should keep their original educational, identity and category certificates ready as required and follow official communications from RBI.

How to Download SBI PO Mains Result 2026 PDF?

Candidates can check the SBI PO Mains Result 2026 through the official Careers section. No login credentials are required to download the publicly available result PDF.

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website at sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.

SBI PO Mains Merit List 2026: How to Check Your Roll Number?

The SBI PO Mains Merit List 2026 is available as a three-page PDF containing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. The PDF does not require individual candidate login.

  • Download the official SBI PO Mains result PDF.
  • Open the PDF using a browser or PDF reader.
  • Use the search option to enter your complete roll number.
  • Check whether the roll number appears in the list.
  • Preserve the result PDF and monitor further Phase 3 announcements.

The published list confirms shortlisting for Phase 3 and does not represent final appointment or selection as a Probationary Officer.

SBI PO Mains Result 2026: What Is the Next Selection Stage?

Candidates shortlisted through the SBI PO Mains examination will proceed to Phase 3, consisting of a Psychometric Test, Group Exercise and Interview. SBI has published the tentative dates for these stages.

The dates are tentative. SBI has stated that individual call letters containing the exact schedule will be released separately.

SBI PO Phase 3 Call Letter 2026 and Interview Schedule

The SBI PO Phase 3 call letters will be issued separately for shortlisted candidates. The official notice schedules the Psychometric Test for 31 October 2026 and Group Exercises and Interviews from 18 November 2026 onwards.

Candidates should regularly check the official SBI Careers page and their registered communication channels for the exact date, time and venue. The bank has stated that shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS or email.

SBI PO Mains Scorecard 2026 and Cut Off Marks

The SBI PO Mains Result 2026 has been released in the form of a roll-number shortlist. The official result PDF does not provide individual marks, section-wise scores or category-wise cut-off marks.

Candidates should check the SBI Careers website for a separate announcement regarding the Mains scorecard and cut-off marks. No exact scorecard release date is specified in the published result PDF.

What If Your Roll Number Is Not in SBI PO Mains Result 2026?

If your roll number is not found in the SBI PO Mains result PDF, first make sure you have checked the correct examination result and entered your complete roll number.

  • Confirm that the PDF is for Advertisement No. CRPD/PO/2026-27/09.
  • Use the roll number from your Mains admit card.
  • Check every digit of your roll number.
  • Try the PDF search option or inspect the list manually.
  • Check the official website for further result-related instructions.

The published shortlist does not provide individual marks or explain the reason for non-shortlisting.

SBI SO Law Officer Selection Process

The selection process has two stages.

  1. Online Written Test: The merit list for this stage is prepared on the combined score of the objective test and the descriptive test. The descriptive test carries 50 marks, with 5 questions to be answered out of 8 in 45 minutes.
  2. Interview: An adequate number of candidates, category-wise, are called based on written test performance. The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.

  • Keep their registration number and login details safe for downloading the call letter.
  • Prepare for the interview, which carries 30% weightage in the final merit.

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 for the recruitment of Assistant (Panel Year 2025) against 650 vacancies. The result is for candidates who appeared in the Mains Examination held on 7 June 2026, and it has been published on 24 September 2026 in PDF format at opportunities.rbi.org.in. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF are shortlisted for the next and final stage of selection the Language Proficiency Test (LPT). There is no interview in this recruitment; final merit is decided purely on Mains marks, subject to qualifying the LPT.

RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 PDF Download

RBI has published two documents alongside the Mains Result: the roll-number list of qualified candidates, and an accompanying result notice. Both are available directly from the official RBI document server.

Document Link
RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Roll Numbers) Download PDF

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition.

RRB NTPC 12th Pass Educational Qualification 2026

Post Name Qualification
Commercial cum Ticket Clerk 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Accounts Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Junior Clerk cum Typist 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions
Trains Clerk 12th Pass or equivalent with 50% aggregate marks, subject to exemptions

Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 13 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply.

Is 50% Required in Class 12 for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates:

  • Scheduled Caste candidates.
  • Scheduled Tribe candidates.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Ex-Servicemen.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Can Graduates Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Fee 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT.

RRB NTPC Examination Fee Refund Rules 2026

  • Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund.
  • The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges.
  • Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification.
  • Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar.
  • Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund.

Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer.

The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions.

  • Number System, Decimals and Fractions

  • Ratio and Proportion

Category Minimum Marks

Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements.

BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027

Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test.

  1. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test.
  3. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test.

Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted.

OBC (NCL), SC and ST 30%

The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

  • Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark
  • Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option

The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

According to the official examination pattern, candidates will be tested in three areas:

Reasoning Reasoning ability

The supplied examination pattern document specifies the number of questions for each section but does not provide a detailed chapter-wise syllabus. Candidates should follow any subsequent trade-specific syllabus or examination instructions published by BHEL.

Selected candidates must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years from the date of joining. Requests for transfer or change in place of posting will not be entertained during the first 20 years.

The notification also specifies that any transfer considered in exceptional personal circumstances would be subject to availability of a suitable position and other company conditions.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Update 27 Oct 2026: The three-year post-qualification experience requirement for Assistant Manager (Finance) is waived for candidates with a graduation degree and CA/CMA Intermediate. The Reasoning & Computer Aptitude section of the online exam for Junior Executive (General) and Junior Executive (Technical) will be bilingual. See the notice

Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC), a Navratna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, has released Advertisement No. CWC/I-Manpower/DR/Rectt/2026/01, dated 17.10.2026, for CWC Recruitment 2026. The Corporation is inviting online applications from eligible male, female and transgender candidates for 327 vacancies across 8 posts: six Assistant Manager posts (General, Technical, Finance, Engineering-Civil, Engineering-Electrical and Engineering-Mechanical) and two Junior Executive posts (General and Technical).

The educational qualification differs by post, from a Post Graduation degree or diploma and B.Tech/B.E. degrees to a graduation or B.Sc degree. The online application started on 17.10.2026, and the last date to apply is 15.11.2026. Applications are accepted online only through the CWC website, www.cewacor.nic.in. The posts are on an All India cadre.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The detailed advertisement gives the post-wise vacancies, eligibility, exam pattern, syllabus, fee, application procedure and the prescribed certificate formats. The direct links are given below.

  • Apply Online Link: www.cewacor.nic.in (Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026)

The categories are (a) Visual Handicapped, (b) Hearing Handicapped, (c) Orthopedically Handicapped, (d) Intellectual Disability and Mental Behaviour, and (e) Multiple Disabilities.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

To meet the CWC eligibility, a candidate must satisfy the nationality, qualification and age conditions as on the last date of application, 15.11.2026.

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of settling permanently, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam with the intention of settling permanently in India. Candidates in the last four groups must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.
  • The minimum age to apply for all the posts is 18 years.
  • All qualifications must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by the Government of India or approved by Government regulatory bodies. Candidates appearing in the final year or final semester are not eligible.
  • Where SGPA/CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it should be converted into equivalent percentage in the online application.
  • No change of category is permitted after registration.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Qualification

The post-wise CWC qualification and experience are given below.

Assistant Manager (General) (01) Two years Post Graduation Degree/Post Graduation Diploma in any discipline Nil
Assistant Manager (Technical) (02) Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering in Agriculture/Food Technology/Food Science/Food Science and Technology/Food Technology Management/Biotechnology Nil
Assistant Manager (Finance) (03) Graduate in Commerce with three years' post qualification experience in Finance & Accounting, OR Graduate in any discipline with CA Intermediate/CMA Intermediate 3 years (for the Commerce graduate route)
Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Civil (04) Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering Nil
Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Electrical (05) Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Electrical Engineering, or in Electrical and Electronics Engineering Nil

For the post of Assistant Manager (Finance), the period of articleship is not counted in the required experience. Only regular employment experience is counted.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) 10 years
Ex-Servicemen, Commissioned Officers including ECOs/SSCOs who have rendered at least 5 years of military service and been released on completion of assignment (including those whose assignment is due to complete within one year of the last date), otherwise than by dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct, inefficiency or physical disability attributable to military service or invalidment 5 years, subject to the ceiling as per Government guidelines
Ex-Servicemen for the post codes 07 and 08 3 years after deducting the number of years of military service
Persons affected by 1984 riots 5 years
  • With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026.
  • For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates).
  • The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves.
  • Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Salary

The CWC salary for the Assistant Manager posts is Rs. 40000-140000 in the E-1 scale, and for the Junior Executive posts it is Rs. 29000-93000 in the S-V scale (IDA pattern). Besides basic pay and IDA, candidates are entitled to other allowances, perks and benefits as per the policies of the Corporation. The notification also lists CPF, contributory pension, gratuity, LTC, performance related pay or variable pay, and medical reimbursement as admissible for regular employees.

Post Name Scale of Pay (IDA)
Assistant Manager (all six posts, codes 01 to 06) Rs. 40000-140000 (E-1)
Junior Executive (General and Technical, codes 07 and 08) Rs. 29000-93000 (S-V)

Selected candidates are appointed on probation. Assistant Manager candidates have to furnish a bond of Rs. 1,00,000 and Junior Executive candidates a bond of Rs. 50,000, to serve the Corporation for a minimum of two years, at the time of joining.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee Intimation Charges Total
SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Serviceman and women candidates Nil Rs. 500 Rs. 500/-
Other candidates (UR/EWS/OBC) Rs. 850 Rs. 500 Rs. 1,350/-
  • The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted.
  • Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets.
  • A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post.
  • On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The CWC selection process depends on the post. Candidates must first register for the online recruitment process for each post.

Post Code Selection Process
01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 06 (Assistant Manager posts) Online Test + Document Verification followed by Interview
07 and 08 (Junior Executive posts) Online Test + Document Verification
  • Candidates are shortlisted from the online test in the ratio of 1:5 for the Assistant Manager posts (Interview) and 1:3 for the Junior Executive posts (Document Verification). The Interview and Document Verification are conducted at Delhi.
  • For the Assistant Manager posts, the Interview carries 30 marks. The minimum qualifying marks in the Interview are 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The weightage of the online exam and the Interview is 85:15.
  • For the Junior Executive posts, appointment is based on the marks obtained in the online test, after successful Document Verification.
  • Each candidate must obtain a minimum score in each section and a minimum total score. The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge test (posts 02 to 06 and 08) and for the Language & Comprehension Abilities Descriptive Test (all posts) are 40% for Unreserved and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • If two or more candidates get the same score, the senior candidate by date of birth is placed higher. A wait list up to 100% of the vacancies in each category may be kept.
  • Cut-offs are applied in two stages, on the scores in individual tests and on the total score. If the exam is held in more than one session, the scores are equated and normalized.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The online examination is of 3 hours in total, with each test separately timed. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks of the question for each wrong answer, and there is no penalty for an unanswered question. Each post has 202 questions and 230 maximum marks.

CWC reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination. Other details will be given in an Information Handout, available with the call letters on www.cewacor.nic.in. CWC Recruitment 2026 Syllabus

The notification says the syllabus is broad and indicative and may change slightly in the examination. The professional/subject knowledge topics are as follows.

  • Assistant Manager (Technical) (02): Agricultural Process Engineering and Storage Systems; Food Engineering and Preservation; Food Chemistry and Nutrition; Food Microbiology and Pest Control; General Biology and Biotechnology; Grain Storage, Quality Control and Chemical Preservation.
  • Assistant Manager (Finance) (03): Financial Accounting (Ind AS, GAAP, bank reconciliation, cash flow statement, final accounts, payroll accounting, cost accounting); Taxation (Income Tax Act, 2025 and Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017); Auditing (company audit, audit reports and certificates, ledger scrutiny, internal control).
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Civil (04): Structural Engineering; Geotechnical Engineering and Geomatics Engineering; Water Resources Engineering; Environmental Engineering; Transportation Engineering; Surveying; Project Management and Planning; Concrete Technology and Prestressed Concrete.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Electrical (05): Electric Circuits; Electromagnetic Fields; Signals and Systems; Electrical Machines; Power Systems; Control Systems; Electrical and Electronic Measurements; Analog and Digital Electronics; Power Electronics.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Mechanical (06): Applied Mechanics and Machine Design; Thermal Engineering and Fluid Mechanics; Manufacturing Technology and Engineering Materials; Production Engineering; Industrial Engineering.
  • Junior Executive (Technical) (08): Basic Agriculture; Botany; Zoology; Chemistry; Physics.

The detailed sub-topics for each of these are given in the notification PDF.

Documents Required for CWC Recruitment 2026

The following documents, in original along with a self-attested photocopy, are required at the time of Interview/Document Verification, as applicable.

  • Valid Interview/Document Verification call letter with a 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm photograph pasted
  • System generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of date of birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with date of birth)
  • Photo identity proof (see the identity verification section of the notification)
  • Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications from Std. X onwards
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC candidates. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate based on the income for FY 2025-26, 2024-25 and 2023-24, issued on or after 01.04.2026 and not later than 15.11.2026.
  • EWS candidates: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27 and in possession on or before 15.11.2026
  • PwBD candidates: Disability certificate in the prescribed format issued by the District Medical Board, and the scribe details if a scribe was used
  • Ex-Servicemen: Copy of the discharge certificate/pension payment order and documentary proof of rank. Those still in defence service must submit a certificate that they will be relieved on or before 15.11.2027.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices/PSUs: No Objection Certificate from the employer
  • 1984 riot affected persons: Certificate from the District Magistrate. Candidates in the non-Indian-citizen categories: certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

Candidates should not send documents directly to CWC before or after Document Verification. Outstation candidates called for Document Verification/Interview are reimbursed A.C. III tier rail fare/bus fare or actual expenses, whichever is less, on production of proof of travel.

How to Apply for CWC Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. A candidate can apply for one or more posts according to the qualification and eligibility, but must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. Not more than one application should be submitted for a particular post.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

  1. Keep ready a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration, a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and the details for online payment.
  2. Go to www.cewacor.nic.in, click the link "Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026" and then "Click here to apply online for Advertisement No. 2026/01".
  3. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and e-mail ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password are generated and also sent by e-mail and SMS.
  4. Fill in the application form. The "Save and Next" option can be used to save the data and verify it. The name of the candidate and the father/husband must be spelt as in the Class 10 certificate/mark sheet.
  5. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  6. Preview the form, click "Complete Registration" after verifying, then use the "Payment" tab to pay the fee and click "Submit".
  7. Take a printout of the application form and the e-receipt. Do not send them to CWC.

Documents to Upload

Document Specification
Photograph Recent passport style colour photograph, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm, file size 20 KB to 50 KB (200 x 230 pixels preferred)
Signature On white paper with black ink (not in capital letters), file size 10 KB to 20 KB (140 x 60 pixels preferred)
Left Thumb Impression On white paper with black or blue ink, JPG/JPEG, 3 cm x 3 cm (240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 20 KB to 50 KB
Hand-written Declaration In English, in the candidate's own handwriting (not in capital letters), JPG/JPEG, 10 cm x 5 cm (800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 50 KB to 100 KB

The text of the declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Visually impaired candidates or others who cannot write may get the text typed and put their left thumb impression below it. The online application is not registered unless the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration are uploaded as specified.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • All details in the online application, including name, category, date of birth, post, address, mobile number, e-mail ID and exam centre, are final, and no change is allowed after submission.
  • Online applications cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is neither refunded nor held in reserve for any other examination. For multiple applications for the same post, only the latest valid application is retained and the fee for the others is forfeited.
  • Candidature at every stage is provisional. CWC can cancel the candidature at any stage if the candidate does not meet the eligibility norms or has given false information.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter, the original photo identity proof and its photocopy to the exam. The name on the call letter must match the photo identity proof. Ration cards and learner's driving licences are not accepted as ID proof.
  • Biometric data (left thumb impression) and a photograph are captured on the day of the exam and verified at Document Verification/Interview.
  • Candidates reporting late are not permitted to take the exam. Candidates may need to be at the venue for up to 4 hours or more.
  • Items not allowed in the exam centre include mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, calculators, watches, handbags, belts, caps, metallic items and eatables. Only half-sleeved clothing and open-toe footwear are allowed.
  • Use of unfair means can lead to disqualification, debarment and an FIR. CWC analyses the answers of candidates to detect similarity patterns.
  • Candidates with disabilities using a scribe get compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour or as advised. The scribe must be one step lower in qualification and must not be a candidate for any post in this advertisement.
  • Intimations are sent by e-mail and SMS only. All announcements and any corrigendum are published only on www.cewacor.nic.in. In case of a dispute over interpretation, the English version prevails.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness. No person dismissed or compulsorily retired from CWC, a State or Central Government department or a PSU, or convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude, is eligible.

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have released the RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN No. 06/2026 for 3,548 vacancies in Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate).

The recruitment includes Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor, Goods Train Manager, Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist posts. Eligible graduates can submit the online application from 08 October 2026 to 06 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

Candidates can check the RRB NTPC Graduate vacancy, salary, qualification, age limit, application fee, selection process, CBT exam pattern, application procedure, signature size and other important details below.

RRB NTPC Graduate Eligibility 2026

RRB NTPC Graduate Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Degree from a recognized University or its equivalent for all four posts under RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026.

Post Minimum Qualification
Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Goods Train Manager Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
Senior Clerk cum Typist Degree from a recognized University or equivalent

Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification on or before 06 November 2026. Candidates awaiting the final result of the qualifying examination are not eligible to apply.

Is Typing Skill Test Required for RRB NTPC Graduate 2026?

No. The Typing Skill Test for Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with for CEN No. 06/2026.

However, candidates appointed to these posts are expected to have basic computer and typing proficiency. Their proficiency may be assessed after joining, and unsatisfactory performance may affect or delay confirmation or promotion.

Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and OBC are different categories. EBC under this CEN is relevant to the fee concession and should not be confused with EWS reservation.

RRB NTPC Graduate Selection Process 2026

The recruitment process for RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026 consists of:

  1. 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 1)
  2. 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT 2)
  3. Document Verification
  4. Medical Examination

There is no Typing Skill Test under CEN 06/2026, including for Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist and Senior Clerk cum Typist.

Candidates will be shortlisted for Document Verification RRB-wise in the ratio of approximately 1:1 against the notified vacancies, based on merit and the applicable recruitment rules.

Important: Candidates must submit only one application against CEN No. 06/2026. Multiple applications to the same or different RRBs can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC examinations.

RRB NTPC Application Correction Window 2026

The application modification window will be open from 09 November to 18 November 2026.

Candidates can modify eligible application details by paying a ₹250 non-refundable modification fee for each occasion.

Details entered under Create an Account, including mobile number and email ID, and the Chosen RRB cannot be changed.

RRB NTPC Graduate Photo and Signature Size 2026

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport photograph. The application portal will capture a live photograph during the online application process.

RRB NTPC Live Photo Requirements

  • The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera.
  • Use a pure plain white background.
  • Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast.
  • Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
  • The entire face must be clearly visible and centered.
  • The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area.
  • Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph.
  • Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph.

Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026.

RRB NTPC Signature Size 2026

File Format JPG / JPEG
File Size 30 KB to 49 KB
Minimum Dimensions 140 × 60 pixels
Scanner Resolution Minimum 100 DPI

Ink Black ink on white paper

The signature must be written by the candidate in normal running handwriting. Signatures written in BLOCK LETTERS, CAPITAL LETTERS or disjointed letters are not accepted.

RRB NTPC Signature Compressor and Image Resizer

If the scanned signature does not meet the RRB NTPC upload requirements, candidates can use the OnlyJobs Image Resizer to resize and compress it before uploading.

For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, keep the signature in JPG/JPEG format, between 30 KB and 49 KB, with minimum dimensions of 140 × 60 pixels.

How to Resize RRB NTPC Signature

  2. Scan the signature clearly.

  4. Keep the image dimensions at least 140 × 60 pixels.
  5. Compress the file to between 30 KB and 49 KB.
  6. Save the final image in JPG or JPEG format.
  7. Check that the signature is complete, clear and clearly visible before uploading.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Post Educational Qualification
HC/GD (Sports Quota) 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized Board/University recognized by the Central or State Government, or equivalent Army Qualification (for Ex-Army personnel)
CT/GD (Sports Quota) Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized Board

Candidates who do not possess the prescribed educational qualification as on 11 November 2026 are not eligible to apply. Educational and sports qualification certificates other than from a Central/State Board must be accompanied by a Government notification declaring the equivalence of that qualification for Central Government service.

Sports Qualification – HC/GD

  • Represented the country in a recognized International Competition/Meet, with clearance from the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
  • Represented a State/UT in the National Games/Championship organized by a National Sports Federation recognized by the Department of Sports, or in National Games organized by the Indian Olympic Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Secured 1st or 2nd position in an individual event in Inter-University Tournaments (for team events, the team must have reached the finals) conducted by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/Inter University Sports Board.
  • Won Gold or Silver medal in an individual/team event at Junior National level Games/Championship/Meet organized by a recognized National Sports Federation.

Sports Qualification – CT/GD

  • Represented a State in Senior/Junior National level Games/Championships organized by a recognized National Sports Federation.
  • Represented a State School Team in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation of India (SGFI), with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Represented a State/UT in Khelo India University Games/Khelo India Youth Games/Khelo India Winter Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  • Represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards, in any sport/game.
Note: The sports achievement/certificate must be from within the last two years from the date of publication of this advertisement (i.e., achievements between 30 September 2024 and 30 September 2026 are eligible). Candidates awaiting results, or not in possession of the required educational/sports certificates, are not eligible and need not apply.

Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the requisite certificate from the competent authority, in the prescribed format, when sought by the Recruitment Board; otherwise their category claim will not be entertained and they will be considered under the General (UR) category. Post Pay Level (7th CPC)

Dearness Allowance, HRA and other allowances are admissible as per Government orders applicable in CRPF from time to time. The New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (implemented vide MoF OM No. 1(7)(2)/2003/TA dated 07.01.2004) applies to selected candidates.

CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence.

1. Documentation

All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST.

2. Marking of Achievements (Merit List Basis)

Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers:

Competition Level Gold Silver Bronze Participation
Olympic Games (Summer/Winter) 100 96 92 80
World Championship/World Cup 90 86 82 70
Asian/Commonwealth Games 80 76 72 60
Asian/Commonwealth Championship or Cup 70 66 62 50
Youth Olympic Games 60 56 52 40
Youth/Junior World Championship or Cup 55 51 47 35
Youth/Junior Asian & Commonwealth Championship 50 46 42 30
SAF Games / recognized International Competition (min. 7 countries, backed by a National-level medal) 40 36 32 26
National Games/Senior National Championship – Individual medal 30 26 22 12
National Games/Senior National Championship – Team event 26 22 18 8
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Individual medal 20 16 12 6
Youth/Junior National Championship/Inter-University/Khelo India – Team event 16 12 8 4

3. Physical Standard Test (PST)

Standard Male Female
Height 170 cm 157 cm
Chest (male only) 80 cm unexpanded, min. 5 cm expansion —
Weight Proportionate to height and age, as per medical standards

Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories.

4. Sports Trial Test

Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained.

5. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Review Medical Examination (RME)

Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME.

Order of Preference (for Merit)

Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny.
  3. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only.
  4. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs.
  5. Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application.
Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)

  • Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc.
  • Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth
  • OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted
  • Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F
  • No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification
  • Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable
  • Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

Important Conditions

  • Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground.
  • Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955.
  • CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason.
  • Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later.
  • The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

A total of 2,008 training slots are on offer across 8 units, spanning trades such as Electrician (Coaching/Power/TRD), Fitter, Welder, Carpenter, Painter, Mason, Pipe Fitter, Diesel Mechanic, Turner/Machinist, Electronics Mechanic, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Machine Tool Maintenance, and Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, among others. Given the scale of this breakdown (dozens of trade rows across 8 separate unit tables), this article presents unit-level totals only; candidates must check the official notification for the exact trade-wise and category-wise slot count for their chosen unit and trade before applying, since a candidate may only select a unit where a training slot exists for their specific ITI trade.

When the prescribed number of SC or ST candidates are not available, those reserved training places may be filled by the other of the two (SC by ST, or vice versa); if still unfilled, they may be filled by candidates not belonging to SC/ST. Similarly, seats remaining unfilled by OBC/EWS candidates will be filled by unreserved category candidates. Reserved PwBD and Ex-servicemen seats are not separate or additional - they are already included within the total slots shown for each trade.

NWR Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

NWR Act Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must have passed the Class 10 examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 examination system) with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (no rounding off) from a recognised Board, and must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the notified trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT). Candidates should have the requisite educational/technical qualification from a recognised Board/Government University/Institute as on the date of submission of the application; those awaiting results of their final exams should not apply.

NWR Act Apprentice Reservation Details

Candidates claiming SC/ST reservation must produce a caste certificate in the Central Government format at the time of Document Verification. OBC candidates must produce a caste certificate and a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, in the Central Government format, along with an OBC declaration. EWS candidates must produce an EWS certificate in the prescribed format. Ex-servicemen and Armed Forces Personnel (or their children) must produce a discharge certificate, or an Armed Forces serving certificate in the case of children of serving personnel, at the time of Document Verification. Ex-servicemen candidates are placed in their appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC); if UR vacancies under the Ex-servicemen quota are unavailable, Ex-servicemen belonging to communities where vacancies are available will be considered.

NWR Act Apprentice Age Limit

Particulars Age
Minimum Age 15 years (completed)
Maximum Age 24 years (not completed)

  • OBC candidates: 3 years' relaxation in upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD): 10 years' relaxation in upper age limit.
  • Ex-servicemen: relaxable by up to an additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces plus 3 years, provided a minimum of 6 months' continuous service was completed (this does not apply to ex-servicemen who have already joined government service on the civil side after availing ex-servicemen status for that engagement).

NWR Act Apprentice Stipend & Training

Training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time; a specific stipend amount is not stated in this notification. No hostel accommodation will be provided - selected candidates must make their own arrangements during training, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961, and will be released upon completion of training. Before commencing training, the selected candidate (or their guardian, if a minor) must enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer.

Category Application Fee (Non-refundable)
All candidates except those listed below ₹100
SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), Women Nil

Fee payment is made online through the payment gateway integrated with the online application, using debit card, credit card, Internet Banking, or similar modes, after the application form is completed and verified for correctness; no change/edit is allowed after fee payment. Any transaction charges for online payment are borne by the candidate. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated, which should be printed and retained.

NWR Act Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is based on a merit list prepared for all candidates who apply against the notification, calculated as the simple average of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) and the percentage of marks in ITI, in the trade in which apprenticeship is sought.

  • For Matriculation percentage, marks obtained by the candidate in all subjects are considered - not the marks of any single subject or group of subjects.
  • For ITI percentage, marks mentioned in the provisional/final certificate are considered.
  • In case two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate is preferred; if the date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed the Matriculation exam earlier is considered first.
  • The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise, trade-wise, and community-wise, equal to the number of slots, in descending order of the percentage of marks obtained.
  • Candidates finally enlisted are subject to verification of original testimonials and production of a medical certificate (as per the notification's Annexure-IV).

Candidates should note that no centralised merit list is formed - each unit's merit list is prepared separately based on candidates who applied for that specific unit.

Medical Fitness

Selected candidates must produce a medical certificate in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification, signed by a Government-authorised Gazetted Doctor not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of a Central/State Hospital. Standards of fitness for Persons with Disability are also specified in the notification, covering Locomotor Disability/Cerebral Palsy (not less than 40% relevant disability), Hearing Impairment (loss of 60 decibels or more in the better ear, including Deaf, Dumb, or Deaf & Dumb candidates), and other benchmark disability categories as defined in the notification.

How to Apply for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026

NWR Act Apprentice Apply Online

Candidates must apply online only, by visiting www.rrcjaipur.in, between 7 October 2026 and 6 November 2026 (23:59 hrs). No physical copy of the application needs to be sent to RRC, and any physical copy received will not be given cognisance. The broad process is:

  1. Log in and fill personal details: Log on to the RRC/Jaipur website and carefully fill in personal details/bio-data, including a valid 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (the original Aadhaar card must be produced at Document Verification).
  2. Select one unit only: Candidates must choose only one Division/Unit from the 8 listed, and should carefully check that a training slot exists for their specific ITI trade in that unit before selecting it, since changes are not allowed after final submission.
  3. Upload photograph: A recent colour photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, not older than 3 months, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–70 KB) with a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses.
  4. Upload signature: A scanned signature (3.5 cm × 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–30 KB).
  5. Pay the application fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) through the integrated payment gateway, after verifying that all application details are correct, since no changes are allowed after payment.
  6. Download and retain printout: After successful submission, download and keep a printout of the application; this will be required at the time of Document Verification, if shortlisted.

Candidates must ensure their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match their Matriculation (or equivalent) certificate - any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment. Candidates should also provide an active mobile number and valid email ID, since all important communication will be sent via SMS/email.

NWR Act Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates may apply for only one unit; submitting more than one application with different particulars (name, father's name, community, photo, qualification, email, or mobile number) will result in summary rejection of all such applications.
  • The decision of the Railway administration on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final.
  • Imparting training on the Railway does not confer any right to absorption/employment on the Railway after successful completion of training; per the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, it is not obligatory for the employer to offer employment, nor for the apprentice to accept it, upon completion of training.
  • No correspondence regarding engagement will be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates should ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria before applying; if erroneously engaged, such candidates will be summarily dismissed without notice at any stage.
  • For help with online submission or printing of the application, candidates can call the helpline number published on the website from 7 October 2026, available 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (except Sundays and holidays) until the last date of application.

BEL Probationary Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for BEL Probationary Engineer posts must meet the educational qualification and age requirements specified in the official notification.

Educational Qualification

  • Electronics: B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Communication or Telecommunication.
  • Mechanical: B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering in Mechanical.
  • General, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates must have First Class in the qualifying degree.
  • SC, ST and PwBD candidates are eligible with Pass Class.
  • Eligible candidates with AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE qualifications in the specified disciplines may also apply.

Other equivalent disciplines and dual specialisations will not be considered. Candidates should carefully verify their qualification against the official notification.

BEL Probationary Engineer Age Limit 2026

The maximum age limit for General and EWS candidates is 25 years as on 1 October 2026. Age relaxation is applicable according to government guidelines.

SC / ST 5 Years
PwBD 10 Years
PwBD + OBC (NCL) 13 Years

BEL Probationary Engineer Salary 2026

Selected candidates will be appointed in E-II Grade with a basic pay scale of Rs. 40,000 - 3% - Rs. 1,40,000. The approximate annual CTC is Rs. 13 lakh. Employees will also be eligible for allowances and benefits, including Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay and Medical Reimbursement, as admissible under company rules.

Category Application Fee

The application fee must be paid online through the prescribed payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable.

BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

The BEL Probationary Engineer online application window opened on 28 October 2026 and will close on 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Interested and eligible candidates should submit their applications through the official recruitment website before the deadline.

Apply Online: BEL Official Recruitment Website

BEL Probationary Engineer Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of a Computer-Based Test (CBT) followed by an interview. Candidates shortlisted through the CBT will be called for an interview in a 1:5 ratio, discipline-wise and category-wise.

  • Computer-Based Test: 85% weightage.
  • Interview: 15% weightage.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 35% for General/OBC/EWS and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates in each stage separately.

BEL Probationary Engineer Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026

The BEL Probationary Engineer Computer-Based Test will contain 125 objective-type questions, including 100 technical questions from the relevant engineering discipline and 25 General Aptitude and Reasoning questions. Candidates will have 120 minutes to complete the examination.

How to Apply for BEL Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can complete the online application process through the official BEL recruitment website by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official website at bel-india.in.
  2. Open the Careers section and find the Probationary Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and eligibility requirements.
  4. Complete online registration using a valid email ID and mobile number.
  5. Fill in the personal, educational and other required details.
  6. Upload the necessary documents, photograph and signature.
  7. Pay the application fee, if applicable.
  8. Submit the application and save or print the confirmation for future reference.

Important: Candidates must verify all information before final submission because changes will not be permitted afterward. There is no requirement to send a hard copy of the application to BEL.
